title: Managing Pre-Authorization Rejections and Query Turnaround Times
summary: Protocol for handling common TPA denial codes including pre-existing illness exclusions and missing clinical justifications.
content: When a cashless pre-authorization is rejected citing pre-existing condition exclusions (e.g. Clause 4.2), the hospital case manager must cross-reference historical duration declared on the initial assessment form against policy inception date. If the onset is within policy tenure, a consultant certificate of acute presentation without prior chronicity must be submitted with an urgent resubmission request within 2 hours.
